title: Projected McKean--Vlasov Dynamics for Entropic Weak Optimal Transport
summary: Unlike classical optimal transport, weak transport costs depend nonlinearly on the conditional law of couplings. This feature is essential in problems involving barycenter, conditional moments, and martingale-type constraints. Meanwhile, such conditional dependence makes ordinary Wasserstein geometry insufficient and calls instead for an adapted Wasserstein viewpoint. In this paper, we investigate the entropy-regularized weak optimal transport via gradient flows in adapted Wasserstein space.
